text.tspan: Moving replicas from Helm to an HPA (tested)
Safe order: hand the field over first
The field still has an owner (the HPA)
Adopting an HPA made with kubectl autoscale:
--take-ownership passes Helm's own label check (invalid ownership metadata)
--force-conflicts takes the fields kubectl-autoscale owns. You may need both.
